list_child.name: list_tax_filings
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete set of tax filings currently being tracked across all clients. This includes filings at every stage, from initial document gathering through final amendment.

get_child.name: get_tax_filing
get_child.desc: Look up a single tax filing using its unique identifier. Returns the full filing record exactly as it is currently stored.

list_parent.name: list_clients
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of clients the practice currently prepares filings for. This is the full client directory used across all engagements.

get_parent.name: get_client
get_parent.desc: Look up a single client record using its unique identifier. Returns the client's full profile as currently stored.

delete_child.name: delete_tax_filing
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a tax filing from the system, removing it from every report and summary. This action cannot be reversed once it has been performed.

set_enum.name: set_tax_filing_status
set_enum.desc: Update the preparation status of a tax filing to reflect where it stands in the workflow. Valid statuses are gathering, prepared, filed, and amended.

set_bool.name: flag_audit_risk
set_bool.desc: Mark a tax filing as carrying elevated audit risk based on the figures it contains. This is typically used after a preparer reviews unusual deductions or discrepancies.

set_ref.name: reassign_tax_filing
set_ref.desc: Move a tax filing onto a different client's account, correcting cases where the filing was created under the wrong entity. Use this only to fix misattributed filings.

send.name: notify_client
send.desc: Send a portal notification to a client regarding their tax filings. Use this to communicate status changes or requests for missing documents.
